candidates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original AnkiQuest study companion named Bluma: a clearly bovine, small purple cow, with a wide rounded cream muzzle, two short cream horns, wide softly rounded cow ears, a lavender forelock, dark brown friendly eyes, purple body, dark plum cloven hooves and a thin tail ending in a purple tuft. Wear an indigo scarf and a small flashcard satchel to belong with the supplied Aki and Ankilope reference art. Match their soft hand-painted digital illustration, warm shading, readable dark contours, large friendly head and small rounded body. The references are style guides only; this is a new cow character, not a recoloured antelope. Bluma must have her own silhouette and must not resemble Milka's cow or HappyCow's logo. No branding, bell or commercial markings. Core happy pose: standing upright in a lively welcoming pose, full body, smiling, holding one blank cream flashcard in one forehoof, other forehoof relaxed or waving. Exactly four cow limbs in total. Clean silhouette readable at 64 pixels. No background, floor, cast shadow, text, letters, watermark, floating decoration or frame. Candidate A: head faces front, slight gentle head tilt, one forehoof gives a compact wave; muted plum-purple coat, cream muzzle and a small cream chest patch.
